audience: business owners and finance staff who check a Barion business wallet

useCases.title: Check the balance of each wallet account
useCases.text: List the currency accounts of the wallet with their balances. Use the balances for a quick cash position check.

useCases.title: Review recent wallet transactions
useCases.text: List the wallet transaction history, newest first, up to 20 items per call. Pass the Id of the last item to read older items.

useCases.title: Look up the details of one wallet item
useCases.text: Find the item in the history list, then read its full details. Details cover payments, fees, transfers, withdrawals, refunds and top-ups.
